title: Gateway sender-store crash-window test comment overstates the simulated scenario
description: Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-lynw. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1845-1848 (test oscore_sender_store_heals_first_accept_crash_window): the comment says the test simulates the crash between the writes of the FIRST-ever accept, but the test actually performs two fully successful compare_exchange calls (:1881-1886) and then deletes the floor - the on-disk shape of a crash between the writes of the SECOND accept. Branch coverage is unaffected (the (Some, None) heal is value-independent), but the comment and test name overstate what is simulated. Fix: reword the comment to say it reproduces the (Some(state), None) crash artifact shape, or actually simulate the first-accept window (single CAS then floor delete).
